title: MANUSCRIPT_STATE
description: Shared editorial state for a scholarly writing project under scriptorium.

title.description: Working title of the manuscript / grant / review.

target_type.description: What kind of artifact this is.

target_venue.description: Journal, funder, conference, or similar. Free text.

target_journal.description: Backward-compatibility alias for target_venue when target_type=manuscript.

current.description: Where the document is in its lifecycle.

submission_target_date.description: Optional target date for the next submission milestone.

core_claims.description: What the document is arguing. Critique skills use this to test whether the prose supports each claim. Transformation skills use this to bound what may be cut.

known_weaknesses.description: Limitations the authors have already acknowledged. Reviewer-simulation will not flag these as 'fatal' since they're known.

preferred.description: Terms the document should use consistently.

forbidden.description: Terms to avoid (jargon, hype language, deprecated nomenclature).

synonyms.description: Map of variant → preferred term for normalization passes.

tone.description: Tonal targets, e.g. quantitative, restrained, evidence-driven.

audience.description: Who the document is written for. Reviewers, funders, clinicians, general scientific audience, …

preserve_citations.description: Transformation skills must not drop or add citations without explicit user instruction.

preserve_statistics.description: Transformation skills must not alter quantitative claims.

avoid_hype.description: Transformation and generation skills should avoid promotional language.

max_word_count.description: Hard upper bound on the document's word count (e.g., journal page limit).

paths.description: Paths to .bib / .json / .yaml bibliography files. Relative to the manuscript root.

sections.description: Optional explicit section manifest for multi-file projects (e.g., Quarto includes).
